name: grass-blasters-os
description: Operate Grass Blasters through Jobber, Zapier, Gmail, Calendar, and the Grass Blasters work queue.

interface.longDescription: A private operating plugin for Grass Blasters LLC. It turns connected Jobber, Zapier, Gmail, and Calendar tools into consistent owner briefs, lead handling, operations triage, and approval-controlled execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Give me the Grass Blasters owner brief. Rank the top issues by urgency and dollar impact, then tell me what you can safely handle.
